description.value: Shawarma 2 Go Grill is an authentic Mediterranean fast-food restaurant in Richmond's Brighouse neighbourhood with over 30 years of shawarma expertise. The menu spans classic chicken and beef shawarma wraps, made-to-order falafels, lamb shank plates, and fusion items like shawarma poutine. It is one of two Richmond locations and offers online ordering with free in-store pickup.
